notes: v2.9.45: PUMA Mobile gains native iPhone external-network support. The existing PC MobileBridge remains the single state/command/order path, while a new outbound-only RemoteRelayClient can push snapshots and pull commands through an HTTPS relay without router port-forwarding. PC UI now exposes Relay HTTPS, a persistent 12-character PUMA device ID, auto-connect, and remote status. A self-hostable in-memory relay server with PC-secret authentication, 6-digit mobile pairing, failed-auth throttling, command allowlisting, and duplicate-command protection is included. A native SwiftUI iPhone app is added with Home, condition candidates, candlestick chart, account/order, settings, real-trading lock, auto-trading controls, Relay mode, and Direct/Tailscale HTTPS mode. The iOS project is built and validated on an iOS Simulator through GitHub Actions. Direct/Tailscale mode can reach the home PC over Tailscale Serve without a public relay server. Trading strategy, breakout/pullback/Bowl-3, concrete, accumulation, watermelon, condition-search, zoom and live-order rules are unchanged.
